Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer repeated attempts using generic web searches without a targeted plan for directly accessing specific, authoritative content. This approach led to repeated failures and lacked adaptation to utilize more focused platforms or methods, resulting in loss of progress. Additionally, there was insufficient attention to accessing niche communities or user-generated content platforms which could have been more fruitful given the context.
